static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: Has a brother living in the UK
static_traits.social_status: Has a few business contacts and industry peers;Relationship tension with partners and clients due to stress and low self-esteem
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;no past psychotherapy history
static_traits.language_features: Expresses clearly,fairly cooperative;low tone with a sense of hopelessness;often uses self-deprecating and absolute expressions(such as 'I am powerless''I can never recover');easily triggered into negative thinking when reviewing business data or Comparing with competitors

basic_info.main_problem: With fierce market competition,business has started declining,and I feel powerless,like a failure.
basic_info.core_demands: Declining business and powerlessness are significantly affecting my mental health and decisions;seeking counseling support.
growth_experiences: Invested all savings to open a restaurant,but the restaurant failed,leading to financial strain and Unemployment;feeling ashamed and thus distancing from friends and family,Declining sleep quality,affected eating habits,stopped running which was once enjoyed.

special_situations.event: When reviewing business metrics and financial data, finds performance declining
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If business metrics decline,it proves my ability is inadequate
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Implements new marketing strategies and seeks business advice, trying to prove my ability through action
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never recover from this setback

special_situations.event: In a fiercely competitive market, compares her own business with competitors
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my business is not as good as competitors',it equals I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Invests more energy in adjusting and optimizing strategies to prove himself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as them,I am a failure

special_situations.event: Past failure experience of the restaurant closing and losing all savings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One major failure means I generally lack ability
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids in-depth communication with family and friends to avoid being evaluated, while redoubling efforts to find solutions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This failure proves I have no ability

special_situations.event: Relationship tension with business partners or clients,when thinking of interacting with family and friends
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If relationships worsen,it means It is all my fault,proving I am not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distancing and reduced social contact to lower the risk of criticism
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me,all Relationship tension is caused by me

core_conflict.wish: Desiring to be recognized as capable, to achieve career success and self-worth
core_conflict.fear: Fear of being looked down on/Being rejected after failure,and falling into deeper financial trouble
defense_goal: Keeps distance from others to avoid evaluation and shame
Maintaining a sense of control over the situation through self-blame

object_relations.object_representation: Others (friends, family) experienced as critics / belittlers

object_relations.self_representation: The weak one suppressed by competition
object_relations.object_representation: Competitors are experienced as powerful and threatening others

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When thinking about or being asked about the restaurant failure and financial losses
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing others will look down on oneself,and that oneself does not deserve to seek help(internalizing potential external evaluations as negation of self)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use a self-blaming tone,such as 'It is all my fault',lowering self-worth,avoiding expressing needs or seeking support.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: Feels shame or nervousness when in contact with friends, family, or business partners
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interpreting others' possibly neutral reactions as criticism or rejection(transference: Projection)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Avoiding deep communication by assuming others' negative intentions,hesitant tone,use sentence patterns like 'they surely look down on me'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing uncertainty about future recovery and job-hunting pressure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Reducing uncertainty and Anxiety by making concrete plans(mature defense)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Pragmatic and concrete in tone, proposes executable steps and time arrangements, emphasizes stage goals and feedback.

manifestations: After the restaurant failure,feeling 'never able to recover',dreams shattered,rising hopelessness
outcomes: Stops running and other self-care behaviors

manifestations: Keeps distance from friends and family due to shame and a sense of failure
Not yet talking to industry peers about the extent of powerlessness

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: Not communicating with family and friends out of shame,turning energy toward self-blame
Reduces help-seeking and stops self-care behaviors such as running

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Frequently evaluating oneself as 'I do not deserve/I am a failure'
Being cautious when interacting with peers,not talking about true feelings

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Speculating that others look down on oneself and will reject oneself
Interpreting Relationship tension as others' negative attitude toward oneself

positive_force: Diligent and with a certain resilience (was able to recover from difficulties in the past, currently actively job hunting)
Willing to try new strategies and seek business advice
Has some industry connections (business contacts and industry peers)
Willing to engage in counseling and conduct behavioral experiments
negative_force: Personalization and self-blame,excessively attributing external factors to one's own inadequate ability
Catastrophizing and absolute thinking(such as 'I can never recover')
Social avoidance caused by shame,Reduced social support
Excessive comparison with competitors triggers inferiority
Stress affects sleep and diet, weakening resilience

antecedent: Checking business metrics and financial data
Thinking of the restaurant failure and losing all savings
target_behavior.core_reason: Core beliefs around 'I am incompetent/failure' and personalized attribution patterns
target_behavior.function: Gaining surface-level control through self-blame,avoiding facing complex external factors and uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Low mood and despair,declining decision quality,affected business and job hunting

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance and distancing(reduced contact with friends,family,business partners)
antecedent: When thinking of failure experiences or being asked about the business
Worrying about being judged or looked down on
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of failure being looked down on by others,inner Low sense of self-worth
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome emotions and potential criticism
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension and Reduced social support,Loneliness and Increased stress

target_behavior.behavior: Declining sleep quality and irregular eating
antecedent: Rising stress,repeatedly thinking about business failure
Ruminating on negative thoughts at night
